answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 83 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an oasis bet on surviving 83 epochs of grading, and every knoll settlement recomputes the haven schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
